name: How should I prepare my home before the interior painters arrive?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before the interior painters arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before painters arrive, homeowners should clear out personal belongings, wall hangings, and small furnishings to keep work areas unobstructed. Large furniture items should be moved to the center of the room so crews can drape them securely with clean plastic sheeting. You should also ensure clear paths through hallways for carrying ladders and supplies. Communicating pet containment plans and any known wall concerns, like past water spots or stubborn stains, ensures the crew applies the proper stain-blocking primers from day one.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remove personal items and wall decor, pull larger furniture into the center of the room for covering, clear walking paths, and secure pets away from the work area.
